Welcome To Cyber Designers

Cyber Designers is a creative advertising and digital marketing agency specializing in bold branding, powerful social media campaigns, and innovative design. We help businesses stand out in a crowded market by crafting visually stunning content that drives real results. From eye-catching photo ads to professional video productions and full website development, our team brings creativity and technology together to grow your brand. All of our ads are promoted and popularized across major social media platforms including Instagram, YouTube, and WhatsApp — putting your business in front of the right audience.

Our Services

From creative design to digital marketing, we offer a complete suite of services to grow your brand online and offline. Every service we deliver is backed by our commitment to quality and our promise to promote your content across major social media platforms — reaching real audiences and driving real results.

Our Team

Behind Cyber Designers is a small but mighty team of passionate creators who live and breathe digital innovation. Together, we combine deep technical knowledge with creative flair to deliver exceptional results for every client we work with.

Rudra Dhakad

Founder & CEO

A visionary technologist and entrepreneur with over 3 years of experience in the tech field. Rudra Dhakad has built award-winning robotic systems including Enzo — the humanoid robot — and a fully functional Mars Rover prototype. Rudra Dhakad leads Cyber Designers with passion, innovation, and an uncompromising eye for quality. Under his leadership, the company has grown into a trusted name for businesses seeking bold digital advertising and creative branding solutions. Rudra Dhakad has represented his state at national-level science and technology competitions, bringing recognition and pride to his region through groundbreaking engineering and design.

Our Pricing

Transparent, affordable pricing for every budget. All prices are fully negotiable — reach out and we will work out the best deal for your needs. Every service comes with social media promotion to maximize your reach.

Popular

Photo Ads

₹2,000 / ad

High-quality photo advertisements designed for Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp. Includes creative design, copywriting, and social media publishing.

Video Designing

₹4,000 / video

Professional promotional videos for your brand or product. Designed for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and WhatsApp Status. Includes script concept and editing.

Best Value

Website Development

₹5,000 / site

Custom-built responsive website for your business. Includes modern design, mobile optimization, and deployment. Perfect for shops, startups, and service providers.

Logo & Branding

₹2,500 / package

Complete brand identity including logo design, color palette, and typography guidelines. Delivered in multiple formats ready for print and digital use.

Poster Design

₹1,500 / poster

Eye-catching posters for events, promotions, festivals, and business announcements. Optimized for both digital sharing and physical printing.

Social Media Management

₹3,500 / month

Monthly management of your social media accounts including content creation, posting schedule, and audience engagement on Instagram, YouTube, and WhatsApp.

Brand Promotion Campaign

₹7,500 / campaign

Full-scale brand promotion campaign across all social media platforms. Includes video, photo ads, posters, and strategic posting for maximum visibility.

Product Photography Editing

₹1,800 / set

Professional editing of product photos for e-commerce listings, social media, and advertisements. Background removal, color correction, and enhancement included.

All prices are negotiable. We understand every business has different needs and budgets. Contact us directly and we will create a custom package that works for you. All advertising services include promotion and popularization across our social media channels — Instagram, YouTube, and WhatsApp.

About Cyber Designers

We are a passionate team of creative professionals and tech innovators building the future of digital advertising. Our philosophy is simple: every business, regardless of its size, deserves world-class branding and digital presence. Whether you are a local shop, a growing startup, or an established company, Cyber Designers has the tools, skills, and drive to take your brand to the next level.
